import operator

dict.__getitem__(flow.metadata, "sandbox_run_id")
dict.get(flow.metadata, "firewall_name")
operator.getitem(flow.metadata, "firewall_action")
dict.__setitem__(flow.metadata, "firewall_error", "error")
dict.__delitem__(flow.metadata, "firewall_base")
dict.pop(flow.metadata, "firewall_permission")
dict.setdefault(flow.metadata, "auth_cache_hit", False)
operator.setitem(flow.metadata, "network_log_target", "target")
operator.delitem(flow.metadata, "sandbox_network_log_path")

meta = flow.metadata
dict.__getitem__(meta, "firewall_error")
dict.get(meta, "firewall_base", None)
operator.getitem(meta, "firewall_permission")
dict.__setitem__(meta, "sandbox_run_id", "run")
dict.__delitem__(meta, "firewall_name")
dict.pop(meta, "firewall_action")
dict.setdefault(meta, "firewall_error", "error")
operator.setitem(meta, "firewall_base", "base")
operator.delitem(meta, "firewall_permission")

dict.__getitem__(flow.metadata, metadata_keys.SANDBOX_RUN_ID)
dict.get(flow.metadata, metadata_keys.FIREWALL_NAME)
operator.getitem(flow.metadata, metadata_keys.FIREWALL_ACTION)
dict.__setitem__(flow.metadata, metadata_keys.FIREWALL_ERROR, "error")
dict.__delitem__(flow.metadata, metadata_keys.FIREWALL_BASE)
dict.pop(flow.metadata, metadata_keys.FIREWALL_PERMISSION)
dict.setdefault(flow.metadata, metadata_keys.AUTH_CACHE_HIT, False)
operator.setitem(flow.metadata, metadata_keys.NETWORK_LOG_TARGET, "target")
operator.delitem(flow.metadata, metadata_keys.SANDBOX_NETWORK_LOG_PATH)

external = {"sandbox_run_id": "external"}
dict.__getitem__(external, "sandbox_run_id")
dict.get(external, "firewall_name")
operator.getitem(external, "firewall_action")
dict.__setitem__(external, "firewall_error", "error")
dict.__delitem__(external, "firewall_base")
dict.pop(external, "firewall_permission")
dict.setdefault(external, "auth_cache_hit", False)
operator.setitem(external, "network_log_target", "target")
operator.delitem(external, "sandbox_network_log_path")

args = (flow.metadata, "sandbox_run_id")
dict.__setitem__(*args, "run")
dict.pop(*args, "default")
operator.setitem(*(flow.metadata, "firewall_name", "github"))
operator.delitem(*(flow.metadata, "firewall_action"))
